intro.fr: Smushi Come Home se joue en multiworld Archipelago depuis 2025.
intro.en: Smushi Come Home has been playable in an Archipelago multiworld since 2025.

text.fr: SomeHumbleOnion sort Smushi Come Home en 2023.
text.en: SomeHumbleOnion releases Smushi Come Home in 2023.

text.fr: xMcacutt publie le 27 novembre 2025 la version 1.0.1 de l'APWorld.
text.en: xMcacutt releases version 1.0.1 of the APWorld on November 27, 2025.

text.fr: La version 1.0.9 sort le 12 janvier 2026 ; c'est la plus récente au 23 octobre 2026 (10 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 1.0.9 is released on January 12, 2026; it is the latest as of October 23, 2026 (10 versions released).
